title: Unit Event — Chase My Ideal Idol! — Episode8 After the Rush

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! receives an offer to appear at Idol Lovers Festival, the big break for many young idol groups. During rehearsals, Airi is shocked by the performance of another group...

rows.Line: Idol Lovers - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did!!
And that was soooo much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That was the best performance!
My heart's still racing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Mine too...
I can still feel all this energy coursing through me.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: That was seriously the best show ever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was...!
And I have a great feeling the audience agrees.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
You were right, Momoi.
This day's become truly unforgettable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I need to apologize for saying what I did earlier. I didn't mean to startle any of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was just having so much fun on stage that I sorta couldn't help myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We could tell.
But I thought what you said was wonderful, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Me too! When you said that, Ai, I mean...
When you said that, Momoi, you gave everyone a huge boost of energy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now you're exaggerating.
I decided to do that after seeing the way you were all performing—

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: No, don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Like I said before we went on stage, the last thing I wanted to do during this performance was embarrass all of you.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Because I knew how incredible you all are...
I knew how unbelievable MORE MORE JUMP! shows are...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: So, I think you can all tell now that Akari's a huge fan of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: She also helped out with your solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you did?!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: W-We can talk about that another time...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
More to the point, I...
After seeing you all perform and spread hope to every member of the audience today...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: We learned so much about the kind of idol group we want to be.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: We wanted to do what you were all doing and spread hope to more and more people. That helped us sing and perform even better...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: We've never been able to connect with an audience the way we just did. It really felt like the best show ever.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: So, I'm really glad we got this chance to perform together! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Enosaki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I should be the one thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The way you all performed on stage filled us with so much energy and a desire to do better.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And today, I was able to take a big step toward reaching my goal.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Your goal...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. And it was made possible by ReLight's performance. You lit a fire inside me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But all I did was take a step forward.
I still have a lot of work left to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, I feel like there's some greater meaning behind us getting to perform together like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's both keep doing our best as idols to spread hope to as many people as possible!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, why don't we excuse ourselves here?
Other groups are still scheduled to perform, so I'd rather not get in their way.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Oh, right.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Okay. But are you sure you don't need to tell her, Akari...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: You being a fan of MORE MORE JUMP! is one thing, but your favorite is...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Ahh! Stop there!
We gotta go! Look, we're getting in everyone's way!
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's like an open book...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can't believe we were performing there just now.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(It used to feel so far away.
I mean, it's always been my dream to see what it's like from up on that stage.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I'm making real progress.
And as long as I don't give up, then I'll get there someday.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I was only able to take this step forward because we found an idol group with the exact same goals as us.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can't stop. I have to keep going.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(No more drawing lines for myself.
I need to do everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In order to become the greatest super idol ever!)
A few days later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Talk Show Host
rows.Line: ...it sounds to me that Idol Lovers went very well again this year!

rows.Speaker: Talk Show Host
rows.Line: Yes. This year, everyone is talking about ReLight, who has been rocketing up the charts recently, and...

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP!
The up and coming idols they did that joint performance with, right?

rows.Speaker: Talk Show Host
rows.Line: That's right! I'm sure our viewers have all heard of ReLight by now, but I feel that MORE MORE JUMP! will continue to...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Their performances at Idol Lovers couldn't have gone better.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (The big talk shows have been featuring them for several days now. Not only that, they've been blowing up on social media. All good news, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
(Something's wrong.
My internet connection seems fine and yet...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No emails pertaining to offers have come in since that day...
